title: Consulting Services for Sports Stadium Development
short_description: Consulting services for evaluating stadium and mixed-use development proposals in Green Bay.
project_scope: Advisory services for the City of Green Bay to evaluate sports stadium and sports-anchored mixed-use development proposals. No technical building data, stadium capacity, spans, gross floor area, or construction scope are stated.
services: Consulting services including evaluation advisory for public-sector stadium and mixed-use proposals; requested disciplines include surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, land use planning, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Stadium-related projects are generally of interest to sbp.
- However, this notice is only for advisory, planning, and evaluation consulting services.
- No structural design, bridge engineering, roof design, or building engineering services are requested.
- The requested disciplines are mainly planning, redevelopment, GIS, and cost estimating, which are outside sbp's core scope.
- Therefore the project has only low strategic relevance.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The document only concerns consulting services for proposal evaluation and provides no stadium size, capacity, area, or development program from which a realistic construction cost estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because the tender is for broad consulting and planning advisory services rather than defined structural engineering services, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting firms with demonstrated experience advising public-sector clients on the evaluation of sports stadium and sports-anchored mixed-use development proposals.
